flows.label: Chat or sticker phrase
flows.detail: The overlay renders in its browser. Hub history observes the Hub chat transport, not the rendered browser pixels. Desktop host discovery shares the one-second process inventory. Pointer polling uses the shared visible transport: one cancellable request, a two-second deadline, no hidden/page-exit requests, and immediate refresh on return. Preview follows local pointer events without OS polling; saved hover and fade behavior remains unchanged. Local 6–7 discoveries use a visibility-scoped Hub SSE subscription. Cards contain a short emoji title and up to three plain-text lines, sharing normal fade/trim settings. Duplicate, expired, malformed and hidden-page deliveries are discarded; previews stay disconnected and teardown releases the subscription. Broadcaster-authored [COMMAND GUIDE] messages receive a static keyboard/COMMAND GUIDE label, reduced content and background opacity, and literal text without animated sticker substitution. Viewer copies and foreign shared-chat messages stay ordinary chat. Guide styling differs from game/joke notices and preserves normal moderation, aging and trim without another timer or transport. Broadcaster-authored 🃏 messages use a separate JOKE label, literal text, 55 percent of normal content opacity and 40 percent of normal card opacity, with no arrival animation. Viewer copies and foreign shared-chat messages stay ordinary chat. The existing message lifetime still controls expiration.

steps.label: Match saved sticker phrase
steps.detail: Apply saved whole-word text substitutions (any casing) before stickers. Saved literal words and phrases stay as text even when a provider code shares the word; expressive aliases and explicit codes remain available without deleting the library. Preserve Twitch-tagged native emote offsets, links and mentions. Replacement text may include saved sticker codes; all substitutions stay overlay-only.

steps.label: Render chat / sticker
steps.detail: Browser holds each message at its chosen readability, then smoothly fades the whole message over the saved fade duration. Original arrival time survives settings polls; removal cancels its animation. The saved message limit may replace old messages sooner; lobby chat stays persistent.
